acceptance: Reproduce the live shape: a taskless chair-review worker is retry_backoff, has no live PID, and references a missing worktree; its observation, commit-progress, cleanup, and lifecycle paths must not raise FileNotFoundError out of poll_workers.

A per-worker missing or unreadable workspace must be handled fail-closed for that worker with an auditable worker-scoped terminal or recoverable outcome, while poll_workers continues to evaluate unrelated workers and due retry delivery in the same phase.
Preserve live-worker identity, lease, task-governance, queue, provider-pause, retry-budget, and worktree safety guards; do not merely catch all exceptions or silently delete active state.
Add focused regressions covering missing taskless chair workspace, missing completed-task workspace, and an unrelated due retry proving poll continuation; preserve existing valid workspace behavior.

Commit pre-review evidence bound to the exact head: changed paths, focused and relevant supervisor tests, full required supervisor suite, git diff --check, rollout boundary, and rollback by normal merge revert.

Use a clean task branch and protected PR to dev, fresh independent Antigravity2 exact-head review, required checks, and merge. This source task must not edit live runtime state, queue files, canonical task state, provider configuration, account grouping, scheduler policy, or services.
task_spec.phase: Supervisor Runtime / Poll Worker Failure Isolation
task_spec.summary: Restore fleet progress without manual cleanup: a missing workspace for one taskless, dead chair-review worker must not abort the entire reserved poll phase or strand unrelated due retries. Deliver a narrowly scoped source fix and evidence through the normal protected PR flow.
task_spec.title: Isolate missing worker worktree poll failures
